title: Complementing unambiguous partially blind counter languages
formal: Is the complement of every language accepted by an unambiguous one-way partially blind multicounter machine accepted by some nondeterministic partially blind multicounter machine?
definitions: Definitions and model details remain incomplete. Specify partially blind counter semantics, endmarkers and acceptance; the output machine is not required to remain unambiguous.

context: The supplied catalogue associates this question with Oscar H. Ibarra. This is an editorial research connection, not a claim of authorship or a personal research agenda. why: This isolates the interaction between unambiguity, weak counters and negation.

import_provenance.original_title: Complementing unambiguous partially blind counter languages
import_provenance.original_statement: Is the complement of every language accepted by an unambiguous one-way partially blind multicounter machine accepted by some nondeterministic partially blind multicounter machine? Equivalently, ask this for unambiguous finite-testable multicounter machines; the output machine need not remain unambiguous.
